attention2.ptxt: Servicing SHVS system involves a danger of electric shock.
For precaution, detect the terminal voltage and use insulation tool and gloves.

item.ptxt: Set ignition “OFF” and keep it for at least 180 seconds, and then disconnect the cable.

attention4.ptxt: Due to self-shutdown process of SHVS system, disconnecting negative (–) cable at the battery within 180 seconds after setting ignition “OFF” may damage the SHVS system.
Disconnect negative (–) cable at the battery 180 seconds after setting ignition “OFF”.

item.ptxt: Wait for at least 10 seconds to set the ignition “ON” after connecting the battery.

attention3.ptxt: Do not set ignition “ON” for 10 seconds after connecting the battery.

If ignition is set “ON” before the time passes, ENG A-STOP warning light may blink. In such a case, set ignition “OFF” and keep it for 90 seconds, and set ignition “ON” again. Then check the warning light does not blink. Furthermore, clear stored history DTC.
In case that the warning light still blinks with ignition “ON” in 90 seconds, diagnose faulty condition.
